Treasury Financing Operations

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Data for September 1975 (from Federal Disability Insurance Trust Fund table)
# Total receipts: 753 (in millions)
# Total expenditures (other than investments): 735 (in millions)

total_receipts = 753
total_expenditures = 735

# Calculate simple 2-value Gini coefficient
# Gini = | receipts - expenditures | / ( receipts + expenditures )
gini = abs(total_receipts - total_expenditures) / (total_receipts + total_expenditures)
print(f'Gini coefficient: {gini:.6f}')
print(f'Rounded to thousandths: {round(gini, 3)}')

# Determine surplus or deficit
if total_receipts > total_expenditures:
    status = 'surplus'
else:
    status = 'deficit'
print(f'Operating status: {status}')
print(f'Difference: {total_receipts - total_expenditures}')
"
